scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Just know that Fenrir plans on joining as well, so it won't be that easy.
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
不過，芬里爾也打算參賽，想獲勝可沒那麼容易。

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
This is my favorite magic buff scroll, so take it as a token of our appreciation.
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
這是我最喜歡的魔法增益卷軸，請收下，以表謝意。

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
It will be useful in the Magic Tournament.
Let's go Iris~!
It's going to start soon~!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
這在魔法大賽中會很有用。
走吧，艾莉絲~！
比賽馬上就要開始了~！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Yes~! Go {0}~
Kafra, wish us luck~!
Do your best {1}.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉絲]
好~！加油，{0}~
卡普拉，祝我們好運~！
{1}，加油哦。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Are you okay?
Where are all these punks coming from anyways?
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
你沒事吧？
這些混混到底是從哪裡冒出來的？

scripts.text:
[Magic Academy Student]
Thanks for helping me.
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[魔法學院學生]
謝謝你幫了我。
你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I am Fenris Fenrir.
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
我是芬里斯·芬里爾。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Thank {0}.
It would have been much worse if {1} hadn't shown up.
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
應該謝謝{0}。
要不是{1}出現，情況可能會糟得多。

scripts.text:
[Magic Academy Student]
Thank you so much {0}.
You saved me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法學院學生]
非常感謝你，{0}。
你救了我。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
You don't meet many people like {0} these days.
You're a good person.
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
現在很少見到像{0}這樣的人了。
你是個好人。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I was on the way to register for the Geffen Magic Tournament with Loki.
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
我正和洛基一起去吉芬魔法大賽報名。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I have a feeling that you will register too {0}.
I hope to meet you in the finals of the Tournament.
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
我感覺你也會報名，{0}。
希望能在大賽決賽見到你。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Oh yeah?
{0} is going to register?
That's interesting.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
哦？
{0}也要報名？
有意思。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
I have a spare magic buff scroll.
I will give it to you as a present.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我有一張多餘的魔法增益卷軸。
送給你當禮物吧。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
I doubt that you can beat Fenrir at the Tournament.
Her fighting prowess is unmatched.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我不認為你能在大賽中打敗芬里爾。
她的戰鬥力無人能及。

scripts.text:
[Loki]
Fenrir, it's time to register.
Let's hurry.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
芬里爾，該去報名了。
我們快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
Yes~! I almost forgot.
It was nice meeting you {0}~!
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
好~！我差點忘了。
很高興認識你，{0}~！

scripts.text:
[Fenrir]
I hope to meet you in combat soon.
scripts.translation:
[芬里爾]
希望很快能在賽場上和你交手。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
My monthly salary...
What am I gonna do?
I have to eat...
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
我的月薪...
我該怎麼辦？
我得吃飯啊...

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
You're not a thief are you?
I don't know what to do about my zeny being stolen.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
你不會是小偷吧？
我的Zeny被偷了，我都不知道該怎麼辦了。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Woo, yeah, what a day~
It seems like all these thieves in Geffen are rich.
They may be good at stealing but they're easy to steal from too.
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亞]
哇，今天可真不錯~
吉芬這些小偷還挺有錢的。
他們雖然很會偷東西，可要從他們身上偷東西，也容易得很。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Hey, why are you crying?
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亞]
嘿，你為什麼在哭？
發生什麼事了？

scripts.text: You tell Lydia about the shoplifters.
scripts.translation: 你把那些商店竊賊的事告訴了莉迪亞。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
What am I going to do?
*sobbing*
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
我該怎麼辦？
*抽泣*

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
(I stole this envelope from one of those thug-looking guys)
....
How much zeny was stolen from you?
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亞]
（這個信封是我從一個看起來像惡棍的傢伙身上偷來的。）
...
你被偷了多少Zeny？

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
1,000,000 zeny!
It's everything that I had.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
1,000,000 Zeny！
那是我的全部積蓄。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Whoa! That's the same amount as what's in this envelope that I stole from that shoplifter.
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亞]
哇！正好跟我從那個商店竊賊身上偷來的信封裡的錢一樣多。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Maybe this is what you are looking for?
Check it out!
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亞]
也許這就是你在找的東西？
看看這個！

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
Let me see...
Wait, this has to be my zeny!
Thank you very much for finding it!
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
讓我看看...
等等，這一定是我的Zeny！
非常感謝你幫我找到它！

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Well... Um, that is...
I didn't say I was gonna give it back to you...
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亞]
呃...那個...
我可沒說要把錢還給你...

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
Thank you very much!!
I will never forget your kindness~!
I'm putting it in the bank right now!
Have a good day~!!! Zap~!!
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
太感謝了！！
我永遠不會忘記你的恩情~！
我這就去銀行把錢存起來！
祝你今天愉快~！！！嗖~！！

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
......
I guess... I did a good thing...?
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亞]
...
我這算是...做了件好事...？

scripts.text: You tell Lydia about your stolen zeny.
scripts.translation: 你把自己的Zeny被偷的事告訴了莉迪亞。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
So, are you asking me for more zeny?
Zeny doesn't grow on trees you know!
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亞]
所以，你還想讓我給你更多Zeny？
Zeny可不會從天上掉下來！

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
I mean it is hers so...
I'll just consider it a donation to the Geffen Magic Tournament.
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亞]
畢竟，那本來就是她的錢嘛...
就當我為吉芬魔法大賽捐款了。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Well, I can't give away any Tournament participants any zeny...
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亞]
不過，我可不能給大賽參賽者送錢...

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
I stole this magic scroll from another thief, so don't worry about taking it.
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亞]
這張魔法卷軸是我從另一個盜賊那裡偷來的，所以你就放心拿去吧。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
I need to get to the Geffen Magic Tournament.
Gotta go!
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亞]
我得趕去吉芬魔法大賽了。
走了！
